assessments.comment: Independent inspection using frozen manifest e3c6253bced7d959cd59873c3d49d166bf5793906bcdf65e49e265076d215499. No scientific execution, network calls, container builds or payload acquisition. Scope includes numerical results, figures and manuscript, with linked components used by their production. Existing event labels/raw recordings are consumed as fixed inputs; recreating the original participant acquisition is not asserted. Unused nested lab-source absolute URL is documented but does not prevent locating the distributed inputs. Historical run exit codes and reported differences are source evidence, not assessor-observed reproduction. Native completion remains provisional with M-05 and D-01 unanswered; binary anchors retained. No actual model/runtime identity asserted.
